title: MOMENT forecasting, anomaly and classification task codes
hypothesis: For three frozen-encoder MOMENT tasks with different native output interfaces, one shared rank-r projection over exact native pre-head representations plus task-specific output heads can preserve each task’s native score while using less total adaptation state than independent rank-r projections. A compact code with eight angles per role (24 scalar coordinates over three roles) applied to paired encoder features immediately before the shared projection will improve at least one task by its frozen task-specific margin versus both hard sharing and equal-byte diagonal gains without causing any other task to miss its native-quality tolerance.
physical_object: One pinned MOMENT-1-base encoder/checkpoint shared by ETTm2 forecasting, tiltAPB2 anomaly reconstruction and ECG5000 classification; task-specific lightweight output operators.
mirror_coordinate: Eight angles per task role (24 scalar codes total); each angle rotates adjacent feature pairs within one of eight contiguous 96-feature groups of the 768-d native pre-head encoder representation, before the shared 768→r projection. This cannot be absorbed independently into the output heads because the projection is shared.
logical_multiplicity: Forecast horizon output, patchwise reconstruction output and ECG class logits on the same physical encoder and one learned projection basis. Task selection is known/oracle and charged as fixed role metadata; no task inference claim.

splits.forecast: ETTm2 chronological standard 12/4/4 month train/dev/audit; OT only; context 512, horizon 96; normalization fitted on training prefix only.
splits.anomaly: Filename-defined first 50,000 raw samples are normal training prefix; the next 10% of this prefix is threshold calibration only; official suffix is untouched audit. Fit normalization on normal training prefix only. Cover audit suffix in contiguous 512-point blocks, final block clipped, each timestamp exactly once.
splits.classification: Official ECG5000 train file is split into fixed stratified 80/20 fit/dev using seed 105301; official test file is fresh audit, opened only after freeze. Fit feature scaler on fit rows only, if required.

model.encoder: Frozen official MOMENT embedder+encoder; intercept exact native pre-head tensor for each task. Forecasting uses official forecast path; anomaly uses deterministic reconstruct path; classification uses official classify path and official mask semantics.
model.mirror: 8 paired-plane rotation angles per task role (24 total learned scalar coordinates across three tasks); identity initialization.
model.training: Seeded task-balanced training, exactly 30 optimizer updates per task (90 task-specific updates total), batch size 8; AdamW lr=1e-3; same cached feature examples, task order and update count across shared/no-code/diagonal/Mirror. Independent rank-r projection controls receive same per-task examples/updates. Freeze before audit.

controls: Official pinned MOMENT native heads: pretrained reconstruction head (zero training), and task-native forecasting/classification heads fitted with the same update budget.
Hard shared rank-r projection and task-specific output operators; no task code.
Same shared projection with eight per-task diagonal gains before projection (24 total scalar coordinates); byte-matched to Mirror.
Mirror: eight paired-plane rotation angles per task role (24 total scalar coordinates) before shared projection.
Independent rank-r per-task projections plus task-specific output operators (unrestricted rank-r upper control).
Seasonal-naive period 96 forecasting control; anomaly threshold fixed from normal calibration only; class majority baseline.

quality.forecast: Audit MASE and MSE separately; native tolerance MASE≤1.02× native task head.
quality.anomaly: Raw pointwise F1, precision/recall, TP/FP/FN, AUPRC and normal calibration FPR; no event adjustment. Only one official event, so no event-level replication claim. Native tolerance F1 within 0.02 absolute of original pretrained reconstruction head.
quality.classification: Audit accuracy and macro-F1; native tolerance accuracy within 2 percentage points.
quality.mirror_specific_gate: At least one task exceeds the native tolerance under Mirror while hard-shared and diagonal-gain shared controls do not, or improves its task-native metric by ≥1% relative to both matched controls, while every other task remains within its native tolerance. No averaged cross-task quality score.

paid_objects: One MOMENT base checkpoint and config once, shared by all methods
Shared projection basis and all per-task output operators
All task-specific Mirror or diagonal coordinates
Native task heads, task IDs/indices, preprocessing scalers, anomaly threshold and metadata

selection: Dev data may select no hyperparameter except the task-wise decision threshold for anomaly, calibrated only on known-normal calibration rows. Rank, rotation structure, update schedule, metrics and gates are fixed here. Fresh ECG test, forecast test suffix and anomaly test suffix remain unopened until protocol freeze.
success_gate: Meet the per-task Mirror-specific gate above; no audit-selected threshold or settings; preserve payload provenance and deterministic metric replay.
failure_gate: All tasks tie/lose to the strongest matched simple control, any task crosses its native tolerance without a compensating per-task gate, or task codes add bytes/compute without useful task-native change.
not_established_gate: If pinned model implementation, exact task-native feature extraction, or official benchmark controls cannot run on available CPU, preserve blocker evidence and leave candidate NOT ESTABLISHED; do not substitute synthetic task labels.
boundaries: Single seed per split; fixed-update screening only, no capacity claim.
One series/dataset per registered task; external validity is narrow.
Anomaly test contains a single event; F1/AUPRC are descriptive and not replicated event-level evidence.
Feature caching is a training convenience; cached pre-head tensors are not inference payload and are charged/reported separately.
Classifier task label is known at inference; no task router quality claim.
Native MOMENT forecast/classification heads are initialized from checkpoint and trained under the same frozen-encoder update budget; anomaly baseline uses its original pretrained reconstruction head.
ETTm2 is fresh to this MA, but ETT dataset family has appeared in earlier program experiments.

amendments.timing: after development harness profiling and before audit; no audit data opened
amendments.reason: Corrected implementation-level feature capture/indexing and completed inference-state accounting for task scalers, task map and anomaly threshold; native task output parity is asserted batchwise. Fixed per-task rank, code family, optimizer, update counts, data partitions and quality gates are unchanged.
amendments.change: Use official pinned native pre-head tensors; apply shared P after Mirror/gain; serialize and charge preprocessing metadata and anomaly threshold; add the registered seasonal-naive and class-majority controls; compute active task-side MAC proxy.
amendments.impact: No model selection or quality threshold was based on fresh/audit data. Development metrics were observed before this amendment; it changes replay/accounting and executes already-listed controls only.

amendments.timing: after fresh audit metrics were calculated; reporting/serialization correction only
amendments.reason: The code has an eight-value code vector for each of three task roles (24 learned scalars total), while the protocol phrase and serialized JSON field were ambiguous and the latter reported 8 as if it were a total.
amendments.change: Clarify 8 coordinates per role (24 total); serialize task_codes_per_role=8 and task_codes_total=24 for diagonal/Mirror, and 0/0 for hard sharing/independent. Recompute actual metadata and complete payload bytes from final serialized files.
amendments.impact: No tensor, training, metric, split, threshold, seed, hyperparameter or audit result changed. Only inference metadata bytes and the written coordinate-count description were corrected.
